name: HealingAgent
description: Native ADK agent that heals failing Playwright .spec.ts tests via a Gemini-backed LlmAgent wrapped in a LoopAgent — genuine tool-calling diagnosis/repair/verify loop, not a deterministic root-cause table. Full replacement of the prior implementation; no composition or fallback to it. Phase 0: reads test_data.json through the contracts loader (v1/v2), writes test_suite.json as schema_version 2, records ADK token usage for the benchmark. Phase 1: apply_patch rejects a block that drops or changes a traced test's { tag, annotation } details object (its link to acceptance criteria). Phase 2: locator dry-runs use the shared resolver (frame / scope aware); same count()==1 and fail-open rules. Phase 4 (session 2): works on test.step-wrapped specs; apply_patch rejects added fixed sleeps; propose_timing_fix suggests a web-first wait; a test that is flaky after a patch is not counted as healed.

inputs.name: report_json
inputs.description: Playwright JSON report path; defaults to the latest report on disk

inputs.name: module_filter
inputs.description: Scope to one module's DOM elements

inputs.name: triage_reruns
inputs.description: false = triage without health check / re-runs / LLM when triage.json is not reused

outputs.name: specs_healed
outputs.description: Spec files with at least one applied patch

outputs.name: not_healable
outputs.description: Tests the model judged a real defect, never patched

outputs.name: triage
outputs.description: Triage counts and product_defect list (never healed)

outputs.name: burn_in
outputs.description: Specs whose fixed tests passed --repeat-each=3 (stable) or not (unstable)

outputs.name: needs_review
outputs.description: Broken locator keys whose replacement failed the identity check

outputs.name: reverted
outputs.description: Locator fixes undone because they broke a passing test

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: Connector mode whose model ran the loop (null when skipped)
